brief_verbatim: I'm the port operations coordinator at Meridian Harbour (51.95 N, 4.14 E). I need an assistant that answers vessel turnaround questions: which vessel is at which berth on a given date, when the next vessel arrives at a berth, what a berth change or stay costs under our tariff rules (port dues, occupancy, demurrage if free time is exceeded, pilotage by LOA, tugs), and it should check current sea conditions at the port when I ask about movement windows. It must use our berth schedule and bunker price sheets for lookups, do any arithmetic exactly, work out relative dates correctly, and refuse anything about crew visas or cargo insurance, which other departments handle. Plain, operational tone for watch officers.
must_answer_topics: next vessel arrival at a berth
berth change or stay costs (port dues, occupancy, demurrage, pilotage by LOA, tugs)
current sea conditions at the port

assumptions.question: Do you need the assistant to provide real-time weather updates or should it rely on pre-stored data?
Should the assistant consider free time allowances when calculating demurrage?
assumptions.assumed_answer: Yes, include free time allowances in demurrage calculations
